name: dao-anon-vote
description: Anonymous yes/no governance votes for a DAO with a public membership roster

scripts.circuit: cd circuits/vote && nargo test && nargo compile
scripts.verifier: cd circuits/vote && bb write_vk --verifier_target evm -b target/vote.json -o target/vk && bb write_solidity_verifier -k target/vk/vk -o ../../contracts/src/verifier/HonkVerifier.sol
